children: Bahia Metals filed an NI 43-101 Technical Report on SEDAR+ supporting its initial 313Mt inferred MRE for the Mangueiros Main nickel-copper-cobalt project, with Ni grade uplift to 0.33% NiTEq when Cu and Co are included.
Formalizes the resource disclosure; de-risks data quality and supports next-step studies.
Scale underpins potential project value; signals development optionality.
Cu/Co by-products lift nickel-equivalent grade ~50%, improving economics.
Low strip can reduce mining costs and improve margins if realized.
PEA will test economics, recoveries, payabilities; potential valuation catalyst.

This formal filing follows the August initial MRE and moves the project from discovery to early study phase. A PEA with metallurgy, recoveries, and payabilities plus any resource upgrade would be needed to become a larger catalyst.
